I get wanting it to work as a full look, not just on its own.

If you are pairing jeans, the best match depends on the leg shape:

Boyfriend jeans: fitted or structured tops like a tucked-in tee, slim sweater, or bodysuit, plus a blazer if you want it more polished
Straight-leg jeans: fitted or relaxed tops, ideally tucked or cropped, with a blazer, denim jacket, or cardigan
Wide-leg jeans: fitted or structured tops like a tucked-in blouse, knit top, or cropped sweater to balance the volume
Flare jeans: fitted tops like slim tees, bodysuits, or blouses work best
Skinny jeans: oversized sweaters, relaxed blazers, or longer tops give the most modern balance

For shoes:

Straight-leg: sneakers, ankle boots, loafers, or heels
Wide-leg: platform sneakers, ankle boots, or block heels
Boyfriend: heels, pointed-toe shoes, sneakers, or flats
Skinny: chunky boots or platform sneakers
If you want to wear cowboy boots, straight, slim, or bootcut styles pair best

turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
structure and stretch.

To help it hold its shape and last longer:

Wash infrequently, about every 5 to 10 wears unless needed sooner
Turn it inside out and wash in cold water on a gentle cycle with mild detergent
Avoid high heat
Reshape while damp and air dry when possible, or use low heat if needed
Spot clean small stains between washes
If you want the fit to look its best, wide-leg styles usually work best when the hem lightly touches or sits just above the floor without dragging 🙂
